definition.def: An adaptation of a book or play is a film or a television programme that is based on it.
examples: ...Branagh's screen adaptation of Shakespeare's Henry the Fifth. [+ of]

definition.def: Adaptation is the act of changing something or changing your behaviour to make it suitable for a new purpose or situation.
examples: Most living creatures are capable of adaptation when compelled to do so.
